story_text:
## Traditional Resin Post-Processing
## The Next-Gen Automated Resin 3D Printer
## Reviewed By
## The World's First All-in-One Resin Printing Experience
## Hassle-Free Printing
Resin post-processing has never been this easy! Three independent modules — print, wash, dry — each runs on its own. Each serviced on its own. One module down? The rest keep working. Repairs stay small. Downtime stays low.
## Advanced Two-stage Washing
S10 performs two automated wash cycles to thoroughly clean most standard prints. A built-in drainage channel in the wash lid directs excess cleaning solution back into the wash tank, helping prevent it from dripping into the resin vat.
## Exclusive Multi-Sided Drying
S10 rotates the build plate 270°, exposing multiple sides of your prints to gentle warm airflow at 35–45°C (95–113°F). PTC ceramic heating eliminates exposed red-hot heating elements, while controlled airflow helps prevent residual cleaning solution from being blown into the resin vat.
S10 offers advanced users the ability to select different washing and drying modes and parameters, allowing you to adapt the times depending on what models you are printing. Extended draining and drying times help remove residual IPA before the build plate returns above the resin vat, minimizing the risk of unwanted drips and resin contamination.
## Where Ideas Become Reality
Send the file, take a clean print. Your gloves stay clean and dry, with no wet resin in between.
A well-engineered and enclosed purification system, helps to keep odors to the absolute minimum, ensuring a nice safe and clean working environment.
Print the ventilation adapter from our Model Library UniGalix, simply replace the back cover of your S10 and connect an external exhaust hose for safer comfort.
## Stop the Sticky Mess
No more shuffling prints between machines and getting sticky resin all over your room. S10 does it all in one.
Let S10 handle the repetitive work of printing, washing, and drying while you focus on what grows your business. Spend less time managing machines and more time designing, fulfilling orders, and serving your customers.
Need to scale up? Connect three S10 printers to one Fluid Hub to streamline your workflow and take on more orders with less hands-on work.
## S10 Fluid Hub: Automated Washing Station
One Fluid Hub connects up to three S10 printers, washing two at the same time while the third waits in queue.
## 15% Longer Solution Life
A two-stage system for serious output: rough wash in one tank, fine wash in a second. Reuse older IPA for the rough pass, keep fresh IPA for the final rinse. Built for high-volume studios, print farms and dental professionals.
## Save Money, Get Time Back
Let's say a studio runs 3× S10 + 1× Fluid Hub, printing 234 batches a month — 9 batches a day, 26 days a month.
Compared to a traditional workflow — where every batch costs hands-on labor for washing, draining, and drying — S10's full automation turns that lost time into real money:
- $456 saved every month
- $5,472 saved every year
- $16,416 saved over 3 years
## Featured In
## Community is Saying
## Print Exactly as Modeled
## Print Stable, Print Confident
Pressure sensors catch foreign objects as small as 1 mm before they cost you a batch.
Smooth printing in low temperatures, even on cold winter days.
A C5 ballscrew delivers less backlash and more accuracy, keeping every layer steady, print after print.
## Real-World Print Data
## Pre-Configured, Straight Out of the Box
New slicing software with ready-to-use preset profiles streamlines your entire workflow.
Wear-Resistant, ABS-Like, Standard, Engineering, and Miniature — five pre-configured resin profiles. Select your resin and print without manual parameter setup.
Dedicated S10 slicing software, compatible with both Chitu and Lychee slicer.
Explore UniGalix: 100+ free models, including designs from Nerikson and Black Forge Games. Pick one, send it to the slicer, and print.
Upload your 3D models and earn money on every download.
## User Friendly
With the foldable curing module, beginners get a complete resin printing workflow, all in one machine. No extra equipment required.
## Specifications
## Reward Options
## Add-Ons
## Warranty Policy
## Shipping & Taxes
- Remote areas: US shipping excludes remote areas. Additional fees may apply for remote delivery addresses.
- Orders to the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and the European Union will be fulfilled from local warehouses to ensure faster delivery and avoid additional customs duties.
- Delivery times: Estimated delivery times vary by region. We will keep backers updated through Kickstarter and email.
## What‘s in the Box
## About UniFormation
Making Resin 3D Printing Simpler, Together. Founded in 2021, UniFormation was built on a shared passion for resin 3D printing and a simple belief: creating should be exciting, not complicated. Our team brings together people who care deeply about engineering, design, and the creative possibilities of 3D printing.
From the GK1 to the GK3 series, we’ve worked to turn that passion into better products, learning from real-world experiences and listening to the community that inspires us. Introducing the S10: A New Way to Print We believe the best innovations come from understanding the people who use them. That’s why community feedback remains an important part of our journey.
With S10, we’re taking another step toward making resin 3D printing simpler, more approachable, and more enjoyable. And we’re excited to share this next chapter with the makers, hobbyists, and professionals who continue to inspire us. We build the technology. You bring the ideas to life.
## Production Stage
Mass production readiness has been a top priority for S10. We have already completed tooling development and multiple rounds of pilot production, allowing us to validate not just the design but the entire manufacturing process: assembly sequence, component tolerances, and build repeatability.
Our production management team brings hands-on experience from complex hardware manufacturing. Working closely with our assembly partners, we have established a full production flow built on three quality gates:
Incoming inspection: every batch of components and materials is checked before entering the line. In-line quality checks: critical assembly and calibration steps are verified at each production station. Final inspection: every completed machine is functionally tested before packaging.
Before full-scale production, we will run a final pre-production batch to confirm capacity, consistency, and delivery readiness. Production will then ramp to mass production, with first orders scheduled to ship in March 2027.
## Timeline
## Contact Us
risks: Every hardware project carries risks. Here is what we see, and what we are doing about each one. Production and timeline. S10 combines printing, washing, and drying in one machine, which makes assembly more complex than a standard resin printer. We have completed multiple prototype generations and trial runs to validate the assembly process. If any stage slips, we will tell backers early and share a revised timeline. Certifications. CE, FCC, ROHS, and UKCA certifications are in progress. Units ship only after certifications are complete. If certification takes longer than planned, shipment will shift accordingly, and we will say so. Product use. Hollow prints may trap wash fluid inside and need a quick manual rinse. This is explained in the manual and tutorial videos. The curing module is optional and sold separately. Shipping and duties. Costs and duties vary by region. We are working with logistics partners to reduce them. In regions we cannot cover, duties remain the backer's responsibility, and this is stated on the rewards page. Budget. Funds go to tooling, production lines, first batch materials, and certifications. A contingency reserve is set aside for unexpected costs.

faq.q: Product Related｜What does "fully automated" mean for S10?
faq.a:
S10's automation involves both hardware and software.
On the hardware side, printing, washing, and drying are integrated into a single enclosed workflow. On the software side, the control system coordinates every stage of the process.

In practice, you can select a model from the content ecosystem, open the slicer, choose your resin, and the software will automatically generate the appropriate parameters. Once you click “Send to Print,” the machine takes over completely. When you return, the onl…

faq.q: Product Related｜How does the S10 auto-washing process work?
faq.a:
The S10 uses a 2 system cleaning cycle. (If using the fluid hub this will be 2 seperate tanks of Cleaning Fluid)
The first cycle effectively serves as a pre-wash / coarse cleaning stage, while the second cycle continues the cleaning process.
For most standard models, this two-cycle process is sufficient to complete the normal cleaning process.
Based on our internal testing under standard resin conditions, using full-platform prints with model heights ranging from approximately 15 mm to 200 mm, w…

faq.q: Product Related｜If one function fails, does the entire machine become unusable? Does greater complexity mean a higher risk of failure?
faq.a:
The S10 uses a modular design, with the printing, washing, and drying functions built as relatively independent modules.
If a problem occurs with one module, maintenance can be focused on the specific affected module. For example, if the washing or drying function requires service, the printing function itself can still operate, depending on the specific issue.
As for the multi-axis movement system, which is one of the more mechanically complex parts of S10, it is not based on unproven technolog…

faq.q: Product Related｜When the build platform returns to the resin vat, will IPA drip into the resin tank?
faq.a: We have optimized the movement speed and dwell time (slower flip speed during cleaning + longer dwell time) to ensure that residual cleaning liquid is fully drained before the platform returns to the resin area. In future firmware updates, we will gradually open more post-processing parameters (cleaning time, cleaning speed, drying time, etc.) so that professional users can fine-tune the process according to their own workflow.

faq.q: Product Related｜How many wash cycles are there, and what changes with Fluid Hub?
faq.a: Both modes use two wash cycles, with the first serving as a pre-wash. With S10 Fluid Hub, you can use older IPA for the first wash and cleaner IPA for the second. The two cycles in standalone mode do not use two separate supplies of cleaning liquid.
